name: dividend_reinvestment_price_vs_total_return
question_template: An investor buys {N} shares at USD {P0} each. During the holding period one cash dividend of USD {D} per share is paid, and the full dividend cash is reinvested on the ex-dividend date at USD {PEX} per share. Reinvestment rule: {MODE} shares. Under "fractional" the cash buys an exact fractional share count; under "whole" it buys the largest whole number of shares and the leftover cash is held uninvested at zero interest and counted in ending value. The ending share price is USD {P1}. Price return is the percent change from USD {P0} to USD {P1}, ignoring dividends. Total return is ending value (all shares held times USD {P1}, plus any leftover cash) divided by initial cost, minus one, in percent. The dividend contribution is total return minus price return, in percentage points; report it.

slots.description: Total number of shares held after reinvestment at the ex-dividend price
Holding-period price return ignoring dividends, in percent
Holding-period total return including reinvested dividend, in percent

program:
def solve():
    n = Q(P["N"])
    p0 = Q(P["P0"])
    pex = Q(P["PEX"])
    d = Q(P["D"])
    p1 = Q(P["P1"])
    mode = P["MODE"]
    if p0 <= 0 or pex <= 0:
        raise ValueError("prices must be positive")
    cost = n * p0
    cash = n * d
    if mode == "fractional":
        bought = cash / pex
        leftover = Q(0)
    elif mode == "whole":
        bought = Q(math.floor(cash / pex))
        leftover = cash - bought * pex
    else:
        raise ValueError("unknown mode")
    shares_end = n + bought
    end_value = shares_end * p1 + leftover
    price_return = (p1 / p0 - 1) * 100
    total_return = (end_value / cost - 1) * 100
    contribution = total_return - price_return
    return {
        "final": contribution,
        "shares_held_end": shares_end,
        "price_return": price_return,
        "total_return": total_return,
    }
